For shelters

ShelterDayOut is a free national directory that sends people to your day-out, field trip, sleepover and cat programs. Listing is free and always will be.

What you can do

Claim or update your listing. Correct your hours, rules, fees or sign-up link, or ask us to remove it.

Choose where outing requests go. People can send outing requests from your listing. They go to your public email (and your program email, if you have one) with the person's contact details. Tell us a better address, or ask us to turn requests off. You approve, match and hand off the animal as you do today, under your own agreements and waivers. We never take bookings or payments.

Add a program. Starting a day-out program? Tell us and we'll list it.

Tell us about your shelter

We use what you send only to respond to you and run ShelterDayOut. See our privacy policy.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
